svg.title: Quality inspector — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as quality inspector, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A vernier calliper with opposed jaws checks the outside diameter of a circular manufactured part. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
